searchTest.title: Search Test

reindex.title: Re-vectorize
reindex.confirm: This will delete existing chunks and re-process all documents. Continue?

help.scope: Determines usage scope: Tenant = specific tenant only, Global = admin + all tenants, Admin = admin only
help.visibility: Controls visibility of admin knowledge bases to tenants
help.embeddingModel: Model for converting text to vectors. Cannot be changed after creation — rebuild KB to switch
help.visionModel: Multimodal model for extracting chart/figure content from PDFs and images. Leave empty to auto-select the first available Vision model
help.extractImages: When enabled, Vision model will automatically recognize image content in uploaded PDFs and include it in the knowledge base index
help.chunkSize: Target characters per chunk. Larger = more context but lower precision. Recommended: 512~1024
help.chunkOverlap: Overlapping characters between chunks. Prevents semantic truncation. Recommended: 10%~20% of chunk size
help.topK: Number of most relevant chunks returned per retrieval. Higher = more comprehensive but may add noise
help.scoreThreshold: Results below this score are filtered. Higher = stricter, 0 = no filtering. Recommended: 0.3~0.7
